name: carboxymethylcellulose
purpose: Emergecy bleeding control. For use by trained emergency responders.
uses: 1. Open package and remove MED-CLOT. 2. Pack MED-CLOT into the wound and use it to apply pressure directly over bleeding source. More than one MED-CLOT may be required. 3. Continue to apply pressure untill bleeding is under control. 4. Wrap and tie bandage to maintain pressure. Seek medical care immediately. Show PRODUCT REMOVAL directions on package to medical personnel.
otcwarn: Do not use if package is damaged.
